Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for South Salmara Mankachar District Court Driver Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for South Salmara Mankachar District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name announced for the South Salmara Mankachar District Court Recruitment 2026 is Driver, offering a government job opportunity.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Driver posts?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Driver post in the South Salmara Mankachar District Court recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview, where candidates can directly attend on the specified date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date for Driver posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview date for the Driver post is scheduled for 19 August 2026. Candidates should report on time.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for the Driver post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Driver post must have a minimum qualification of Class VIII Passed from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Driver post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Driver post is Rs. 9000 Per Month, as per the official notification details.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these posts?
faq.answer: These posts are of a Contractual government job type, offering employment for a specified period.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for these posts?
faq.answer: The job location for these posts is Fekamari, Assam, within the jurisdiction of the South Salmara Mankachar District Court.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Driver post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Driver post will be conducted through a Walk-in Interview, as detailed in the official notification.
